tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Stormap's practical guides on building with AI agents (OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude, coding agents, browser automation, RAG, MCP, AI news). Returns titles, URLs, Markdown URLs and short descriptions. Use get_guide to read one.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Return one Stormap guide as clean Markdown with front matter (title, URL, dates, tags). Accepts a slug ("how-to-install-hermes-desktop") or a stormap.ai post URL.

tools.name: ai_visibility_score
tools.description: Score how well AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) can find, read and cite a public web page: 0-100 score, letter grade, pass/fail checks (AI answer-bot access in robots.txt, server-rendered content, title/meta, JSON-LD, canonical, llms.txt, sitemap) and a prioritized fix list. tools.name: check_ai_crawler_access
tools.description: Check whether AI crawlers (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot) may access a public URL according to its robots.txt, and score the page's machine readability (status, title, meta description, canonical, JSON-LD, server-rendered text). tools.name: generate_llms_txt
tools.description: Generate an llms.txt file (llmstxt.org format) for a public website. Uses the site name, summary and pages you pass; anything missing is filled from the homepage and sitemap.xml. Returns the file text plus notes on how to improve it.

tools.name: generate_ai_robots_txt
tools.description: Generate robots.txt rules for AI crawlers from a policy: "open" (allow all), "balanced" (allow search and user-triggered fetchers, block bulk training crawlers) or "block" (block all). Optional per-bot overrides, allowed/blocked paths, sitemap and crawl delay. No network access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_guides, get_guide, ai_visibility_score, check_ai_crawler_access · Private data: generate_llms_txt · Public sink: get_guide · Destructive: generate_llms_txt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_guides, get_guide, ai_visibility_score, check_ai_crawler_access · Private data: generate_llms_txt · Public sink: get_guide · Destructive: generate_llms_txt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
